scientific_integrity: Proof uses a complete finite rational-arithmetic enumeration of all 5922 feasible unordered container multisets, an independent exact-rational recursion for each case, and an algebraic all-time survival law for optimizers. Priority is supported only by inspected sources, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to rank-three binary six-column generator matrices with two balanced three-column containers under synchronous independent uniform reads. Does not cover higher dimensions, other capacities, or noisy/nonuniform/asynchronous recovery.
title: Sharp binary \([6,3]\) two-container coverage depth and Fano-line extremizers
